Container.Name: Hermes Dashboard
Container.Requires: A running "Hermes Agent" from the same maintainer
Container.Overview:
Hermes Agent is a local, self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research, with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, and builds a deepening model of who you are across sessions.
This template uses the official Hermes Agent docker image, and it is configured to run the agent's Web Dashboard using the HERMES_UID and HERMES_GID environment variables, a browser-based UI for managing your Hermes Agent installation API keys, sessions, skills, update hermes, and more.
Warning: the dashboard is meant to be used locally, you will get access to your API keys. It is not recommended to expose it to the internet as it doesn't have strong security measures in place. As always, Tailscale is a good option for secure remote access.
It is encouraged to spend time reading https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/ to understand the project and its capabilities, and to configure it properly for your use case. This template will expose the Web Dashboard to configure the agent (which will be give you access to its setting, including your API keys), but it won't give you access to the agent's "brain" (the file where it stores its knowledge and skills) or to the CLI. You can find instructions to use both in the project documentation.
Familiarity with docker exec might be required to configure the agent itself, but the dashboard should be enough to configure it and monitor its activity.
If you encounter issues with this template (not the underlying application), please open an issue in the template repository, not in the Hermes WebUI repository, as it is not maintained by the same team.

Config.Name: HERMES_HOME Unraid location
Config.Description: Location where the container stores all user data (config, API keys, sessions, skills, memories)

Config.Name: GATEWAY_HEALTH_URL
Config.Description: URL (IP, Docker and Port) of the gateway health endpoint (if you modified the default Gateway port, or local container name, adapt this value -- to get the running container name, from a termainal, run: docker container ls)

Config.Name: Hermes Shared Source Volume
Config.Description: A Docker named volume (do not change: using a folder path will not work) that auto-populates from the image (target must be the same for all hermes templates)
